▽ △
Description:
std::uint8_t optinal member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined sequence number
8 bit header field.
The value range for version shall be:
0x00...0xFF : valid
For transmission, the middleware shall increase the sequence number with 0x01 for each
transmission request, if it is not provided by the application. If the sequence number reaches the
maximum value, then it should re-start with 0x00.
Visibility:
protected
